mentions.name: HeliosCAD
mentions.description: This is a code-based CAD application built on the author's Aetheris geometry kernel, designed for LLMs first and foremost. Work in progress includes adding visual programming to the UI and IntelliDraft, a new drafting approach closer to how mechanical engineers actually do sketching.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building a working CAD software based on my own geometry kernel, Aetheris.

https://github.com/yuechen-li-dev/HeliosCAD

Since it's code based CAD for LLMs first and foremost, I'm trying to add visual programming into the UI, as well a new way of drafting that's closer to how mechanical engineers actually do sketching called IntelliDraft.
